title: Blitz serving roundtable — prep & quick actions
agenda_items: 1) Quick pulse (90s each) — recent regressions, paging noise, deploys
2) Hot path signals (5 min) — top 3 surfaced by SRE
4) Serving runtime: KV cache anomaly + mitigation plan (10 min)
6) Dedicated capacity bump request review (5 min)
body:
Purpose: rapid weekly triage for serving/runtime/infra/console teams. Keep cadence tight — 30 minutes max. Use this doc as the single source for decisions and actions; migrate to jira tickets for work items after the meeting.

Facilitation notes:
- Kickoff: 30s summary of customer-facing impact (if any).
- Timeboxing: o’clock timer visible; move long discussions to follow-up breakout.
- Recording: quick notes only — Rafa to capture decisions and assign owners live.
- If something needs >10m, flag as follow-up and assign an owner.

Prep checklist (do before meeting):
- Attach latest latency heatmap to the calendar invite (Ellie).
- Runtime: confirm if KV cache eviction thresholds changed this week (Maya).
- Infra: capacity budget summary + request link (Diego).
- SRE: list of alerts noisy in last 48h (Samir).

Meeting etiquette reminders:
- One speaker at a time; audible short updates only.
- If you’re driving an action item, write the minimal acceptance criteria in the chat.

Parking lot topics (to triage next week or a dedicated sync):
- Re-architecture of prefix caching for long-tail customers.
- Console UX: token-level cost export format.
- Dedicated autoscaler edge-case on mixed-quant models.
action_items: (AI-1) Maya: reproduce KV cache spike with a deterministic script and post runbook draft — due 2026-03-16
(AI-2) Ellie: update latency dashboard to include p99.9 by model shard and share link — due 2026-03-15
(AI-3) Diego: prepare Dedicated bump justification doc + estimated $ impact — due 2026-03-18
(AI-4) Samir: dump noisy alerts and propose three filters to reduce paging — due 2026-03-14
(AI-5) Rafa: create follow-up RFC template for routing fallback changes and create jira ticket "RFC-serve-21" — due 2026-03-13
